I added a 0.25s sleep after each sandbox call in `tests/test_payments.py`. I didn't run the test, since it's an integration test that calls the live sandbox.

- There's a new `SANDBOX_CALL_INTERVAL = 0.25` constant, with a comment noting the 5 requests/second limit. At that limit calls need to be at least 0.2s apart, so 0.25s leaves some margin.
- `test_charges_roundtrip` now runs `time.sleep(SANDBOX_CALL_INTERVAL)` after each POST. This adds about 1s to the test.
- If more sandbox tests get added, you may want a shared fixture or throttle helper instead of sleeping in each test, because the limit could still be hit across tests that run back to back.

I also saved the sandbox rate limit to EngramDB as a project note so future sessions know about it.
